3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: I was making my 14th scratch on the wall when the warden opened the cell door. It was my first time seeing a person since the military detained me.

4.speaker: Player
4.text: “You are no judge. You are just a usurper.”

5.speaker: Narrator
5.text: He put handcuffs on my wrists and we started walking.

6.speaker: Iosef Lancea
6.text: “Normally, you are supposed to rise when a judge enters this room, Mr. Rayne.”

7.speaker: Narrator
7.text: I barely had enough energy to ask where we were going. I just assumed the worst. He told me today was the day of my trial.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: While we were walking, I caught a glimpse of my reflection in a metal door. My beard had grown and my cheeks were sunken. The conditions I was held in were showing.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: Soldiers grabbed my arms and led me inside. They gestured towards the table in the court room.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: Looking around, I saw the flags of the Sordish Armed Forces hanging down from the walls, covering the crests of the Supreme Court.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: The room was completely empty except for me and the soldiers on guard. I looked at the vacant seats on the bench.

16.speaker: Narrator

17.speaker: Narrator

19.speaker: Narrator
